service.name: X-Ray Imaging Software Products
service.description: TWAIN module, reconstruction algorithm libraries, advanced post-processing filters, and SDK/API integration support for X-ray imaging systems.

q1.question: What software products does Athlos offer?
q1.answer: Athlos offers a TWAIN module, reconstruction algorithm libraries, advanced post-processing filters, and SDK/API integration support for X-ray imaging systems.

q2.question: Can Athlos software be licensed independently?
q2.answer: Yes. Software products are available as part of an Athlos sensor system or as independently licensed components for OEM integration.

q3.question: What SDK and integration support does Athlos provide?
q3.answer: Athlos provides SDK and API integration support to help OEM partners and system integrators incorporate Athlos imaging software and algorithms into their own products and workflows.
